_doc: Plan 7 Phase 5 — questions across contexts (approved by the owner 2026-09-19). Expected numbers are NOT stored: each part's sql runs against the context's source at eval time (they reconcile with control_totals.csv, which the NT-Report dashboards reconcile with). A question is correct when every expected number shows up in the rows of an answer part from an accepted context, the expected computed value / period warning is there, and an 'unanswerable' question returns no number.
